task.prompt: Verify all 24 acceptance criteria from the 'project-creation-in-group' plan are satisfied by the current implementation. The plan covers: page-based create project UI (Vue 3), API Gateway handler (Go), auth-service backend (Go), proto changes, OpenAPI spec, i18n, tests (unit + E2E), docs, and traceability. All tasks are marked completed [x]. Produce a verification report that checks each criterion against actual source code.
task.ideal_result: A verification report with each of the 24 acceptance criteria rated PASS/FAIL/SKIP, with evidence (file paths, code snippets, test results) for each verdict, and actionable fix instructions for any FAIL criteria.

rules.description: `New project` on ProjectsPage opens `/dashboard/projects/new` (page), not a dialog
rules.check: Verify ProjectsPage.vue uses router.push to navigate to 'project-create' route instead of opening CreateProjectDialog

rules.description: Create Project page requires selected Group and project name (inline validation errors)
rules.check: Verify CreateProjectPage.vue has required validation for group selection and project name field

rules.description: Group selector shows human-readable group names (loaded from `listGroups()`)
rules.check: Verify CreateProjectPage.vue loads groups via listGroups() and displays human-readable names in selector

rules.description: Frontend sends canonical JSON: `name`, `description`, `group_id`, `visibility`
rules.check: Verify org.ts createProject sends payload with name, description, group_id, visibility fields (no label field)

rules.description: API Gateway accepts `name` as canonical; `label` as deprecated fallback
rules.check: Verify API Gateway org_handler.go HandleCreateProject uses name as canonical with label as deprecated fallback with warning log

rules.description: API Gateway uses proper error mapping (not always 500)
rules.check: Verify API Gateway org_handler.go HandleCreateProject uses mapGrpcCodeToHTTP() for error responses

rules.description: Backend creates Project under Group with paired Ontology UUID v4 (`ontology_id`)
rules.check: Verify auth-service CreateProject generates UUID v4 for ontology_id and pairs it with the created scope

rules.description: Visibility is validated: project cannot be more public than parent Group
rules.check: Verify visibility enforcement logic: project visibility <= parent group visibility is validated server-side

rules.description: Backend validates caller has at least Maintainer role in parent Group
rules.check: Verify auth-service CreateScope checks caller has Maintainer+ role in parent Group, returns ErrForbiddenInsufficientRole otherwise

rules.description: User becomes Owner of created Project (Owner membership auto-assigned)
rules.check: Verify auth-service CreateProject auto-assigns Owner membership for the creator via UpsertMembership

rules.description: On success: Toast shown (`Project created successfully`) + redirect to `/project/:id/workspace`
rules.check: Verify CreateProjectPage.vue shows success Toast and redirects to /project/:id/workspace after creation

rules.description: Structured logging in all modified backend handlers (INFO request/success, ERROR failure)
rules.check: Verify API Gateway and auth-service handlers have slog.Info for request/success and slog.Error for failures

rules.description: All tests pass (frontend vitest, API Gateway Go test, auth-service Go test, E2E Playwright)
rules.check: Run frontend vitest, API Gateway go test, auth-service go test and verify all pass

rules.description: Project appears in list with human-readable `name`
rules.check: Verify ProjectsPage.vue displays project name (not label or slug) in the project list

rules.description: Specs updated: `US-org.projects.create.md`, `UC-org.projects.manage-project-lifecycle.md`, requirements
rules.check: Verify spec files exist: US-org.projects.create.md, UC-org.projects.manage-project-lifecycle.md, REQ-FUN.ORG.project-creation.md

rules.description: Design updated: `design/pages/create-project.pen` created
rules.check: Verify design/pages/create-project.pen file exists

rules.description: OpenAPI spec updated with new contract
rules.check: Verify openapi.json contains CreateProjectRequest with name, group_id, visibility fields and 201/400/403/404/409/422 responses

rules.description: i18n keys added for Projects flow (en + ru)
rules.check: Verify en.json and ru.json contain projects.* keys for the create project flow

rules.description: Antora docs updated (organization-model.adoc)
rules.check: Verify organization-model.adoc documents project creation flow, visibility inheritance, Owner auto-assignment

rules.description: Traceability.ttl updated with new artifact relationships
rules.check: Verify traceability.ttl contains entries for new/updated artifacts: US, UC, req, design, frontend pages, API handler, tests

rules.description: Test Quality Score (TQS) >= bronze (6.0) for new tests
rules.check: Verify TQS of new test files meets bronze threshold (6.0) — check for B1-B7 anti-patterns

rules.check: Verify no B1-B7 anti-patterns (sleep, assertTrue(true), empty catch, tautologies, inline tests in source, etc.) in test files
